summary: Contestants analyze banking and credit principles, evaluate financial services, and apply secure practices for transactions, account management, and compliance with regulations. The event includes objective and application evaluation methods. Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes for orientation
No more than sixty (60) minutes for testing
No more than ten (10) minutes for wrap-up
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
competencies: Analyze factors affecting credit choices, including credit scoring, costs of credit, and cybersecurity, and describe types of loans and application processes
Analyze the functions of commercial paper, secured transactions, and bankruptcy
Identify and distinguish the evolving functions and services of traditional banks, online banks, and financial institutions
Develop and implement strategies for secure cash handling and fraud and identity theft prevention
Describe the FDIC’s evolving role in the banking industry
Describe procedures for electronic banking including mobile apps, biometric authentication, and real-time payments
Define and perform steps to open, maintain, and reconcile checking accounts using traditional and online platforms
Define and calculate both simple and compound interest
Describe the advantages and disadvantages of traditional digital savings and investment platforms in the banking industry
Identify government regulations in banking including compliance with digital finance laws and data protection
Explain the fundamentals of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology
Describe the custody, storage, and risk of digital assets, and associated security considerations
Evaluate ethical considerations and consumer protection in modern banking
Explain the types and functions of digital currencies, including cryptocurrency and stablecoins
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
No equipment, supplies, or materials other than those specified for an event will be allowed in the testing area

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests or facsimiles (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
